OPENS Ch 31 — HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR: leading-toward-final-resurrection-capstone arc. The chapter likely articulates the structural-pivot from Ch 28's salvation-history-compression (Cain-to-Esther) + Ch 30's covenant-honor toward Ch 33's manna-as-bread-of-angels (Ps 78:25 anchor) + Ch 34's four-kingdoms apocalypse + Ch 36's final-resurrection-capstone. The structural-pivot pattern parallels: 1 ENOCH 70-71 (the structural-pivot from the Parables to the Astronomical Book — γ.4.4 Mäṣḥafä Hēnok structure); JUBILEES 47-50 (the structural-pivot from Genesis-rewrite to halakhic-Sabbath-laws — γ.4.5 Mäṣḥafä Kufāle structure). The Meqabyan structural-pivot preparation likely articulates an intermediate-doxology + transition-to-final-arc theme, in keeping with the trilogy's compositional-architecture (cf. 3 Mq 1:28 + 3:15 + 1 Mq 1:14 chapter-closing-transitions γ.4.8.D + γ.4.8.E entries — the chapter-as-structural-pivot is a Meqabyan compositional-signature).

Tewahedo providence-tradition preserves divine-providence as the integrating-anchor for the trilogy's anti-Sebelyanos polemic-architecture: providence ensures the martyrs'-victory + the vindication-of-faithfulness.
